args.text: PS2SDK dma_registers.h documents DMA_SET_CHCR(DIR, MODE, ASP, TTE, TIE, STR, TAG) and defines TTE at bit 6, STR at bit 8. PS2SDK dma_tags.h defines DMA_TAG_END as 7, DMA_TAG_CNT as 1, and describes END as QWC then end; CNT as QWC then next tag. PS2SDK gif_tags.h defines GIF_REG_AD as 0x0e. PS2SDK gs_gp.h defines GS_REG_ZBUF_1 as 0x4e, and GS_SET_ZBUF packs ZBA into bits 0-8, ZSM at 24, and ZMSK at 32.
args.purpose: Use the official PS2SDK definitions to interpret static packet fields in a game reverse-engineering audit.
